agreement_rule: _strict_s0.agrees on the extracted decide_bytes' verdict: READY iff rc 0 and a PDF; E0 iff rc 0 and no PDF; any other reason iff rc != 0, the first ! message is in _strict_s0.expected_messages(reason, token, mode), and the reported line (DecideBytes.ReportedLine) equals the oracle's l.N (both absent when the file ends)

upper_bound_95.scope: the disagreement rate over files drawn by THIS generator (version, weights, seed), not over L_S0: a class of files the generator does not draw is not bounded (C-85)
